decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 11 October 2005, the erection of a single storey rear extension measuring part 7.1 metres/ part 4.3 metres deep, 3.63 metres wide and 2.5 metres high and single storey detached building, for use as a playroom measuring 6.5 metres long, 4.3 metres wide and 4 metres high to top of ridged roof was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

The development falls outside the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes A and E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because:

a)	the outbuilding would be within 5 metres of the proposed extension and the combined volume would result in the proposal exceeding the permitted development limit and 

b)	The outbuilding and rear extension together would cover more than half of the garden area.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension to house and a detached single storey outbuilding providing a playroom to rear.
